_comment: WASP-39b baseline v4 (nautilus, n_eff 5000): baseline v3 (the chem_presolve chain, per-instrument noise inflation, log10gamma down to -3) on a 100-layer chemistry grid, uniform in log P over the same 1e-9..7.6 bar, at 528 lanes. Keys starting with _ are dropped (run_smc.make_config). Every key but walltime_seconds enters the target manifest, so run it in a fresh SMC_RETRIEVAL_OUT_DIR. Env, not Config: NAUTILUS_N_EFF=5000, VULCAN3_CHEM_RHS=grouped (see run_nas_w39b.pbs).
_nz: Config.nz (gpu preset 62) -> the chemistry profile's nz -> vulcan3 cfg.nz: pco is logspace(P_b, P_t, nz) between the W39b.yaml bottom (7.6 bar) and the RT top art_ptop_bar (1e-9 bar), so only the layer count changes (6.2 -> 10.1 layers/decade). The RT keeps its own 67-layer ART grid (art_nlayer, case.py), shown converged. resolution_study (notes.md): 100 uniform layers put the science parameters within ~0.26 sigma (mean) / ~0.43 (median, c_o) of the converged 284-layer posterior; 62 within ~0.45.
_cfg_overrides: REPLACES case.py's dict, so Rp (1.21 R_J, case.py) is restated. rtol 0.2: the PRESOLVE's step tolerance (W39b.yaml default). ini/final_update_photo_frq 1: photolysis every step in both programs (lowkzz_fix, notes.md). queue_compact: run_queue tail compaction 528 -> 396 -> 264 -> 132 lanes; the chem_retry program inherits all of cfg_overrides but rtol (config_schema.retry_profile).
_chem_presolve: as baseline v3: every draw is presolved at rtol 0.2 within 3000 accepted steps (a start only, no RT, never kept), then solved at rtol 0.05 within 5000 warm from the presolve column (or from its original start where the presolve did not certify); only that solve's VULCAN certificate keeps it.
_noise: one b per group (NIRISS, G395H_NRS1, G395H_NRS2), each log10_uniform on prior_noise_inflation (0.5, 3); needs infer_noise_inflation (on in the gpu preset). n_dim 15.
_priors: as baseline v2/v3: log10gamma lower bound -3; lnKzz keeps [ln 0.1, ln 1000].
_lanes: x FFI_BLOCKS_PER_SM 3 (run_nautilus) = 528 lanes; n_batch defaults to 3 x 528 = 1584 unless NAUTILUS_N_BATCH is set. 100-layer lane probe (job 94050, GH200, memory fraction 0.90): 528 lanes peak 64.4 GiB in the cold presolve program (40.2 GiB warm presolve / certify) of the allocator's 85.6, 4.78 draws/s; 396 lanes 50.9 GiB, 4.59 draws/s; 660 compiled at ~79 GiB but was never timed.
_walltime: nautilus governor 46 h for a 48 h PBS wall (target-free: a RESUME may change it)
